WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.Admission
  FROM Patient AS p
  WHERE (
    upper(COALESCE(p.Diagnosis, '')) LIKE '%APS%'
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination AS e
      WHERE e.ID = p.ID
        AND e.Thrombosis = 1
    )
  )
    AND (
      upper(COALESCE(p.Diagnosis, '')) LIKE '%SLE%'
      OR upper(COALESCE(p.Diagnosis, '')) LIKE '%RA%'
      OR upper(COALESCE(p.Diagnosis, '')) LIKE '%MCTD%'
      OR upper(COALESCE(p.Diagnosis, '')) LIKE '%PSS%'
      OR upper(COALESCE(p.Diagnosis, '')) LIKE '%BEHCET%'
      OR upper(COALESCE(p.Diagnosis, '')) LIKE '%WG%'
      OR upper(COALESCE(p.Diagnosis, '')) LIKE '%PM%'
      OR upper(COALESCE(p.Diagnosis, '')) LIKE '%PN%'
      OR upper(COALESCE(p.Diagnosis, '')) LIKE '%AORTITIS%'
      OR upper(COALESCE(p.Diagnosis, '')) LIKE '%COLLAGEN%'
    )
  ),
  groups AS (
    SELECT '+' AS Admission, 'admitted to the hospital' AS patient_group
    UNION ALL
    SELECT '-', 'followed at the outpatient clinic'
  )
SELECT
  g.patient_group,
  COUNT(l.LDH) AS normal_ldh_measurements
FROM groups AS g
LEFT JOIN cohort AS c ON c.Admission = g.Admission
LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l
  ON l.ID = c.ID
 AND l.LDH < 500
GROUP BY g.Admission, g.patient_group
ORDER BY CASE g.Admission WHEN '+' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;

Please give me one row per patient group showing the number of lactate dehydrogenase measurements within the normal range recorded for that group, with the admitted group's row first. Label the rows 'admitted to the hospital' for the Admission = '+' group and 'followed at the outpatient clinic' for the Admission = '-' group. arguments.sql:
WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.Admission
  FROM Patient p
  WHERE lower(COALESCE(p.Diagnosis, '')) LIKE '%thrombo%'
    AND lower(COALESCE(p.Diagnosis, '')) LIKE '%autoimmune%'
), counts AS (
  SELECT c.Admission, COUNT(l.LDH) AS normal_ldh_measurements
  FROM cohort c
  LEFT JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = c.ID AND l.LDH < 500
  WHERE c.Admission IN ('+', '-')
  GROUP BY c.Admission
)
SELECT CASE Admission
         WHEN '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital'
         WHEN '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic'
       END AS patient_group,
       normal_ldh_measurements
FROM counts
ORDER BY CASE Admission WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END;

WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.Admission
  FROM Patient p
  WHERE (upper(COALESCE(p.Diagnosis, '')) LIKE '%APS%'
     OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Examination e WHERE e.ID = p.ID AND e.Thrombosis = 1))
    AND (upper(COALESCE(p.Diagnosis, '')) LIKE '%SLE%'
      OR upper(COALESCE(p.Diagnosis, '')) LIKE '%RA%'
      OR upper(COALESCE(p.Diagnosis, '')) LIKE '%MCTD%'
      OR upper(COALESCE(p.Diagnosis, '')) LIKE '%PSS%'
      OR upper(COALESCE(p.Diagnosis, '')) LIKE '%BEHCET%'
      OR upper(COALESCE(p.Diagnosis, '')) LIKE '%WG%'
      OR upper(COALESCE(p.Diagnosis, '')) LIKE '%PM%'
      OR upper(COALESCE(p.Diagnosis, '')) LIKE '%PN%'
      OR upper(COALESCE(p.Diagnosis, '')) LIKE '%AORTITIS%'
      OR upper(COALESCE(p.Diagnosis, '')) LIKE '%COLLAGEN%')
), groups AS (
  SELECT '+' AS Admission, 'admitted to the hospital' AS patient_group
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '-', 'followed at the outpatient clinic'
)
SELECT g.patient_group,
       COUNT(l.LDH) AS normal_ldh_measurements
FROM groups g
LEFT JOIN cohort c ON c.Admission = g.Admission
LEFT JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = c.ID AND l.LDH < 500
GROUP BY g.Admission, g.patient_group
ORDER BY CASE g.Admission WHEN '+' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        l.ID AS patient_id,
        l.Date AS test_date,
        l.DNA AS anti_dna_level,
        CAST(
            (julianday(l.Date) - julianday(p.Birthday)) / 365.2425
            AS INTEGER
        ) AS age_completed_years,
        p.Diagnosis AS diagnosis,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) DESC, date(l.Date) ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE p.Admission = '+'
      AND l.DNA IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    patient_id,
    test_date,
    anti_dna_level,
    age_completed_years,
    diagnosis
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1;

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT
    ID,
    CASE Admission
      WHEN '+' THEN 'Admitted to the hospital'
      WHEN '-' THEN 'Followed at the outpatient clinic'
    END AS care_setting
  FROM Patient
  WHERE SEX = 'F'
    AND Birthday <= date('2026-10-09', '-50 years')
    AND Admission IN ('+', '-')
),
positive AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE CAST(RNP AS REAL) >= 4
)
SELECT
  e.care_setting,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.ID IS NOT NULL THEN e.ID END) AS patients_with_elevated_anti_rnp,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.ID IS NULL THEN e.ID END) AS patients_without_elevated_anti_rnp
FROM eligible AS e
LEFT JOIN positive AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
GROUP BY e.care_setting
ORDER BY e.care_setting;

WITH latest_igg AS (
  SELECT
    ID,
    IGG,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date DESC) AS rn
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE IGG IS NOT NULL
),
setting_counts AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN p.Admission IN ('+', '+(') THEN 'admitted to the hospital'
      WHEN p.Admission = '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic'
    END AS setting,
    COUNT(*) AS patients,
    SUM(
      CASE WHEN l.rn = 1 AND l.IGG > 900 AND l.IGG < 2000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS normal_latest
  FROM Patient AS p
  LEFT JOIN latest_igg AS l
    ON l.ID = p.ID AND l.rn = 1
  WHERE p.Admission IN ('+', '+(', '-')
  GROUP BY setting
)
SELECT
  setting,
  ROUND(100.0 * normal_latest / patients, 1) AS percentage
FROM setting_counts
ORDER BY CASE setting
  WHEN 'admitted to the hospital' THEN 1
  ELSE 2
END;

  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE CASE
    WHEN TRIM("U-PRO") LIKE '%(%)%' THEN
      CAST(
        SUBSTR(
          TRIM("U-PRO"),

    WHEN TRIM("U-PRO") GLOB '[0-9]*' THEN
      CAST(TRIM("U-PRO") AS REAL)
    ELSE NULL
  END >= 100
),
high_ldh AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE LDH >= 500
)

FROM Patient p
JOIN high_ldh h ON h.ID = p.ID
JOIN proteinuria u ON u.ID = p.ID
ORDER BY p.ID;

       ELSE 0

)

WITH qualifying AS (
  SELECT
    p.ID AS patient_id,
    p.Birthday,
    p.Diagnosis AS overall_diagnosis,
    e."Examination Date" AS examination_date,
    e.Symptoms AS symptom
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
  WHERE e.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
    AND LOWER(e.Diagnosis) NOT LIKE '%susp%'
    AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(e.Symptoms) <> ''
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    patient_id,
    symptom,
    overall_diagnosis,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY Birthday ASC, patient_id ASC, examination_date DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM qualifying
)
SELECT patient_id, symptom, overall_diagnosis
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1;

WITH sexes(sex, sort_order) AS (
  VALUES ('male', 1), ('female', 2)
),
abnormal AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE GPT >= 60
)

  COUNT(p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM sexes AS s

  ON CASE

       WHEN p.SEX IN ('female', 'F', 'Female', 'FEMALE') THEN 'female'
     END = s.sex
 AND NOT EXISTS (
       SELECT 1
       FROM abnormal AS a
       WHERE a.ID = p.ID
     )
GROUP BY s.sex, s.sort_order
ORDER BY s.sort_order

WITH qualifying AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.Admission, p.Birthday
    FROM Patient AS p
    JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE l.RBC < 3.5
),
grouped AS (
    SELECT
        Admission AS care_setting,
        COUNT(*) AS patient_count,
        AVG(
            CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
            - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)
            - (strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', Birthday))
        ) AS avg_age
    FROM qualifying
    WHERE Admission IN ('+', '-')
    GROUP BY Admission
)
SELECT
    care_setting,
    patient_count,
    ROUND(avg_age, 1) AS average_completed_age
FROM grouped
ORDER BY CASE care_setting WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END;

  SELECT
    p.ID,
    (julianday('2026-10-09') - julianday(p.Birthday)) / 365.2425 AS age_years
  FROM Patient AS p
  WHERE p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
    AND (julianday('2026-10-09') - julianday(p.Birthday)) / 365.2425 < 70
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) >= 64
    )
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(age_years), 1) AS average_age_years
FROM eligible;

counts AS (

    SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(SEX)) IN ('F', 'FEMALE', 'W', 'WOMAN') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS women,

  FROM eligible
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * women / NULLIF(women + men, 0), 1) AS women_percentage
FROM counts;

WITH molecules_with_single_bond AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM bond
  WHERE bond_type = '-'
),
oxygen_counts AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN a.element = 'O' THEN 1 END) AS oxygen_count
  FROM molecules_with_single_bond AS m
  LEFT JOIN atom AS a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(oxygen_count), 4) AS average_oxygen_atoms_per_molecule
FROM oxygen_counts;

WITH carcinogenic AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM molecule
  WHERE label = '+'
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_carcinogenic,
    SUM(
      CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM atom AS a
        WHERE a.molecule_id = c.molecule_id
          AND a.element = 'F'
      ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    ) AS without_fluorine
  FROM carcinogenic AS c
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * without_fluorine / NULLIF(total_carcinogenic, 0), 2) AS percentage
FROM counts;

transcript.name: explore_schema

arguments.sql:
WITH bond_counts AS (
  SELECT bond_type, COUNT(*) AS n
  FROM bond
  WHERE molecule_id = 'TR010'
  GROUP BY bond_type
), ranked_bonds AS (
  SELECT bond_type, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY n DESC, bond_type) AS rn
  FROM bond_counts
)
SELECT rb.bond_type,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS carcinogenic
FROM molecule AS m
LEFT JOIN ranked_bonds AS rb ON rb.rn = 1
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR010';

    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond

atoms AS (
    SELECT a.element
    FROM atom AS a
    JOIN molecules_with_single_bond AS m USING (molecule_id)

FROM atoms;

sql:
WITH molecule_bond_groups AS (
  SELECT
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(b.bond_id) > 0
       AND SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(b.bond_id)
        THEN 'every bond is single'
      ELSE 'not every bond is single'
    END AS bond_group
  FROM molecule AS m
  LEFT JOIN bond AS b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
)
SELECT
  bond_group,
  SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      AS carcinogenic_minus_non_carcinogenic
FROM molecule_bond_groups
GROUP BY bond_group
ORDER BY CASE bond_group
  WHEN 'every bond is single' THEN 1
  ELSE 2
END;

Please report, for molecules in which every bond is a single bond: the number of carcinogenic molecules minus the number of non-carcinogenic molecules. And for all other molecules: the same difference (carcinogenic count minus non-carcinogenic count). Rules: label '+' means the molecule is carcinogenic; label '-' means non-carcinogenic; bond type '-' denotes a single bond; each molecule belongs to exactly one of the two groups.

    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(b.bond_id) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(b.bond_id)
        THEN 'every bond is single'
      ELSE 'not every bond is single'
    END AS bond_group
  FROM molecule AS m
  LEFT JOIN bond AS b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label

FROM molecule AS m

WITH atom_counts AS (

    SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carbon_atoms,

  FROM atom
  GROUP BY molecule_id
),
bond_counts AS (
  SELECT
    molecule_id,
    COUNT(*) AS number_of_bonds,

  SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS number_of_atoms,
         SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carbon_atoms,
         SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'Cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chlorine_atoms
  FROM atom GROUP BY molecule_id
), bond_counts AS (
  SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS number_of_bonds,
         SUM(CASE WHEN bond_type IN ('double', 'triple') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multiple_bonds
  FROM bond GROUP BY molecule_id
), carbon_touching_bond_counts AS (
  SELECT b.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS carbon_touching_bonds
  FROM bond b JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  JOIN atom a ON (a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2)
             AND a.element = 'C'
  GROUP BY b.molecule_id
), inventory AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label AS carcinogenicity_label,
         COALESCE(ac.number_of_atoms,0) AS number_of_atoms,
         COALESCE(bc.number_of_bonds,0) AS number_of_bonds,
         COALESCE(ac.carbon_atoms,0) AS carbon_atoms,
         COALESCE(ac.chlorine_atoms,0) AS chlorine_atoms,
         COALESCE(ct.carbon_touching_bonds,0) AS carbon_touching_bonds,
         COALESCE(bc.multiple_bonds,0) AS multiple_bonds
  FROM molecule m LEFT JOIN atom_counts ac USING (molecule_id)
  LEFT JOIN bond_counts bc USING (molecule_id)
  LEFT JOIN carbon_touching_bond_counts ct USING (molecule_id)
  WHERE COALESCE(ac.carbon_atoms,0) > 0
)
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY carbon_touching_bonds DESC, number_of_atoms DESC, molecule_id ASC) AS rank,
       molecule_id, carcinogenicity_label, number_of_atoms, number_of_bonds,
       carbon_atoms, chlorine_atoms, carbon_touching_bonds, multiple_bonds
FROM inventory ORDER BY rank

  SELECT

    COUNT(*) AS number_of_bonds,

  FROM bond
  GROUP BY molecule_id
),
carbon_touching_bond_counts AS (
  SELECT
    b.molecule_id,
    COUNT(*) AS carbon_touching_bonds
  FROM bond AS b
  JOIN atom AS a1
    ON a1.atom_id = b.bond_id
   AND a1.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  GROUP BY b.molecule_id

    COALESCE(bc.multiple_bonds, 0) AS multiple_bonds

  LEFT JOIN atom_counts AS ac ON ac.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  LEFT JOIN bond_counts AS bc ON bc.molecule_id = m.molecule_id

  number_of_atoms,
  number_of_bonds,

  multiple_bonds

ORDER BY rank

sql:
WITH bond_counts AS (
  SELECT bond_type, COUNT(*) AS bond_count
  FROM bond
  WHERE molecule_id = 'TR377'
    AND bond_type IN ('-', '=')
  GROUP BY bond_type
),
pair_counts AS (
  SELECT
    b.bond_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
      WHEN a1.element <= a2.element
        THEN a1.element || '|' || a2.element
      ELSE a2.element || '|' || a1.element
    END) AS element_pair_count
  FROM bond b
  JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
  JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
  WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR377'
    AND b.bond_type IN ('-', '=')
  GROUP BY b.bond_type
)
SELECT
  bc.bond_type AS bond_kind_symbol,
  bc.bond_count,
  COALESCE(pc.element_pair_count, 0) AS element_pair_count,
  m.label AS carcinogenicity_label
FROM bond_counts bc
LEFT JOIN pair_counts pc ON pc.bond_type = bc.bond_type
CROSS JOIN molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR377'
ORDER BY bc.bond_count DESC, bc.bond_type ASC;

WITH bond_counts AS (
    SELECT
        c.atom_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_bonds,
        SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS single_bonds,
        SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type <> '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multiple_bonds
    FROM connected AS c
    JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    GROUP BY c.atom_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        c.atom_id2 AS atom_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_bonds,
        SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS single_bonds,
        SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type <> '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multiple_bonds
    FROM connected AS c
    JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    GROUP BY c.atom_id2
), atom_bond_totals AS (
    SELECT
        atom_id,
        SUM(total_bonds) AS total_bonds,
        SUM(single_bonds) AS single_bonds,
        SUM(multiple_bonds) AS multiple_bonds
    FROM bond_counts
    GROUP BY atom_id
)
SELECT
    a.element AS element_symbol,
    COUNT(*) AS atom_count
FROM atom AS a
JOIN atom_bond_totals AS t ON t.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE t.total_bonds > 0
  AND t.single_bonds = t.total_bonds
  AND t.multiple_bonds = 0
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY a.element;
